const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /redacted
+{
+  "reviewer": "codex/gpt-5.6-sol",
+  "base": "66203cc",
+  "head": "d5b2b68",
+  "verdict": "findings",
+  "findings": [
+    {
+      "id": "F1",
+      "severity": "major",
+      "category": "correctness",
+      "file": "src/linear.ts",
+      "line": 154,
+      "claim": "The timestamp-only watermark can permanently skip eligible items when a page boundary contains more than 50 items with the same updatedAt value.",
+      "evidence": "src/linear.ts:99 and src/linear.ts:159 cap the query at 50, src/linear.ts:154 filters the next query with updatedAt > watermark, and src/server.ts:215 plus src/server.ts:251 advance to that timestamp; with 51 items at T, the 51st item is excluded forever.",
+      "fix": "Use exhaustive cursor pagination or a composite updatedAt plus item-id cursor, and never advance past an unexhausted timestamp cohort."
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "F2",
+      "severity": "major",
+      "category": "correctness",
+      "file": "src/triage.ts",
+      "line": 56,
+      "claim": "Comma-joining label and link arrays makes contentKey non-injective, so a content change can reuse an old verdict key.",
+      "evidence": "src/triage.ts:56-59 hashes comma-joined arrays; a review probe produced the same SHA-256 for labels [\"bug\",\"security,z\"] and [\"bug\",\"security\",\"z\"], although src/triage.ts:138-148 changes the latter verdict from low to high risk.",
+      "fix": "Serialize each sorted array unambiguously with JSON or length-prefixed escaped elements before hashing."
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "F3",
+      "severity": "major",
+      "category": "reliability",
+      "file": "src/linear.ts",
+      "line": 70,
+      "claim": "Crash recovery observes only the first 100 comments, so an existing operation comment outside that page is treated as absent and retried.",
+      "evidence": "src/linear.ts:70 requests comments(first: 100), while src/server.ts:171 searches only that array and src/server.ts:186 retries on a miss; an issue with the operation comment outside the first page cannot be adopted and can remain unsettled indefinitely.",
+      "fix": "Query the comment directly by operation id or paginate comments until the id is found or the connection is exhausted."
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "F4",
+      "severity": "major",
+      "category": "security",
+      "file": "src/linear.ts",
+      "line": 143,
+      "claim": "The Linear boundary trusts cast JSON instead of validating it, allowing malformed external data to crash triage, poison the watermark, or violate the operation-id contract.",
+      "evidence": "src/linear.ts:143 casts response.json() to generic T, src/linear.ts:157-168 consumes item and comment shapes without runtime parsing, and src/linear.ts:176-180 accepts a returned comment id without checking that it equals the caller-supplied id later applied at src/server.ts:132.",
+      "fix": "Parse strict per-operation GraphQL envelopes with Zod, validate updatedAt as an ISO timestamp, and reject any created comment whose id differs from commentId."
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "F5",
+      "severity": "major",
+      "category": "spec-conformance",
+      "file": "src/server.ts",
+      "line": 311,
+      "claim": "server.ts reads and carries the Linear credential even though TECH requires linear.ts to be its only holder.",
+      "evidence": "docs/specs/CND-1_conductor-daemon/TECH.md:57 says linear.ts is the only holder of LINEAR_TOKEN, but src/server.ts:285, src/server.ts:307, and src/server.ts:311 inspect and pass current.linearToken.",
+      "fix": "Move credential lookup, missing-token handling, and authenticated client construction behind an API owned by linear.ts."
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "F6",
+      "severity": "minor",
+      "category": "spec-conformance",
+      "file": "src/triage.ts",
+      "line": 150,
+      "claim": "The verdict schema is declared but never executed on the production path, so verdicts are TypeScript-shaped rather than Zod-enforced.",
+      "evidence": "src/triage.ts:29-39 defines verdictSchema, but src/triage.ts:150-163 returns the raw object and repository search finds parse or safeParse calls only in tests.",
+      "fix": "Construct the rules verdict through verdictSchema.parse and validate hydrated persisted verdicts before publishing them."
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "F7",
+      "severity": "minor",
+      "category": "spec-conformance",
+      "file": "src/server.ts",
+      "line": 301,
+      "claim": "server.ts writes the persistent watermark directly, contradicting the contract that store.ts is the plugin's only writer.",
+      "evidence": "docs/specs/CND-1_conductor-daemon/TECH.md:59 assigns store.ts as the only writer, but src/server.ts:296-302 implements Watermark with bb.storage.kv.get and bb.storage.kv.set.",
+      "fix": "Move the watermark persistence implementation behind store.ts and leave server.ts dependent on a read-write store method only."
+    }
+  ],
+  "coverage": [
+    {
+      "file": "src/linear.ts",
+      "status": "read"
+    },
+    {
+      "file": "src/server.ts",
+      "status": "read"
+    },
+    {
+      "file": "src/store.ts",
+      "status": "read"
+    },
+    {
+      "file": "src/triage.ts",
+      "status": "read"
+    },
+    {
+      "file": "test/dispatcher-intake-thread-only.test.ts",
+      "status": "read"
+    },
+    {
+      "file": "test/fakes.ts",
+      "status": "read"
+    },
+    {
+      "file": "test/settings-cli-parity.test.ts",
+      "status": "read"
+    },
+    {
+      "file": "test/triage-exactly-once.test.ts",
+      "status": "read"
+    },
+    {
+      "file": "test/triage-ignores-own-comment.test.ts",
+      "status": "read"
+    },
+    {
+      "file": "test/triage-park-and-only-mode.test.ts",
+      "status": "read"
+    },
+    {
+      "file": "test/triage-rules-first.test.ts",
+      "status": "read"
+    },
+    {
+      "file": "test/triage-verdict-schema.test.ts",
+      "status": "read"
+    },
+    {
+      "file": "test/triage-writes-comment-only.test.ts",
+      "status": "read"
+    }
+  ],
+  "checklist": [
+    {
+      "item": 1,
+      "status": "fail",
+      "evidence": "src/linear.ts:70,99,154 and src/server.ts:215,251; F1 and F3 show skipped intake and incomplete crash-window adoption."
+    },
+    {
+      "item": 2,
+      "status": "fail",
+      "evidence": "src/triage.ts:29-39 defines the strict shape, but src/triage.ts:150-163 does not apply verdictSchema on the production path; see F6."
+    },
+    {
+      "item": 3,
+      "status": "pass",
+      "evidence": "src/triage.ts:95-163 returns only source rules, and src/server.ts:225-236 parks ambiguity without a model or comment call."
+    },
+    {
+      "item": 4,
+      "status": "pass",
+      "evidence": "src/linear.ts:28-43 exposes only comment observation and creation, and src/server.ts:127-132 performs one comment mutation surface with no item mutation API in src/."
+    },
+    {
+      "item": 5,
+      "status": "fail",
+      "evidence": "src/triage.ts:52-59 excludes updatedAt but comma-joins arrays, allowing distinct title/description/labels/links projections to collide; see F2."
+    },
+    {
+      "item": 6,
+      "status": "pass",
+      "evidence": "Repository search found no threads.spawn or threads.send in src/, and src/server.ts:277-363 registers no thread or agent-tool surface."
+    },
+    {
+      "item": 7,
+      "status": "pass",
+      "evidence": "src/server.ts:225-236 persists outcome.reason when parking, and src/server.ts:305-324 wires only the dispatcher triage schedule."
+    },
+    {
+      "item": 8,
+      "status": "pass",
+      "evidence": "src/server.ts:22-84 declares scalar descriptors for cadence, limits, Linear binding, and triageOnly; src/server.ts:255-274 plus src/server.ts:326-360 print mode, cadence, and limits through bb conductor status."
+    },
+    {
+      "item": 9,
+      "status": "fail",
+      "evidence": "src/server.ts:285,307,311 touches the Linear credential outside linear.ts and src/linear.ts:143 does not validate the untrusted response boundary; tests otherwise inject fakes or replace global fetch."
+    },
+    {
+      "item": 10,
+      "status": "fail",
+      "evidence": "src/server.ts:300-301 writes persistent KV outside store.ts; src/store.ts:18-60 otherwise defines exactly verdicts and runs, repository search found no DELETE in src/, and the production host serializes schedule sweeps so no applied-to-uncertain call path was found."
+    }
+  ]
+}
*** End Patch";
const result = await tools.apply_patch(patch);
text(result);

  .reviewer == "codex/gpt-5.6-sol" and
  .base == "66203cc" and
  .head == "d5b2b68" and
  (["approve", "findings"] | index($verdict)) != null and
  ([.findings[].id] | length == (unique | length)) and
  all(.findings[];
    (["blocker", "major", "minor", "nit"] | index(.severity)) != null and
    (["correctness", "security", "spec-conformance", "reliability", "style"] | index(.category)) != null and
    (.file | type == "string") and
    (.line | type == "number") and
    (.claim | type == "string") and
    (.evidence | type == "string") and
    (.fix | type == "string")
  ) and
  all(.coverage[]; (["read", "skimmed", "not-read"] | index(.status)) != null) and
  ([.checklist[].item] | sort) == [range(1; 11)] and
  all(.checklist[]; (["pass", "fail"] | index(.status)) != null and (.evidence | type == "string"))
' --arg verdict "$(jq -r .verdict docs/specs/CND-1_conductor-daemon/review.json)" docs/specs/CND-1_conductor-daemon/review.json
diff -u <(rg --files src test | sort) <(jq -r '.coverage[].file' docs/specs/CND-1_conductor-daemon/review.json | sort)
jq -c '{verdict, findings: (.findings | length), severity_counts: (.findings | group_by(.severity) | map({key: .[0].severity, value: length}) | from_entries), checklist_fails: [.checklist[] | select(.status == "fail") | .item]}' docs/specs/CND-1_conductor-daemon/review.json
git status --short","workdir":"/redacted","yield_time_ms":10000,"max_output_tokens":12000});
text(JSON.stringify({exit_code:r.exit_code,output:r.output}));

const r = await tools.exec_command({"cmd":"jq -e '
  .reviewer == "codex/gpt-5.6-sol" and
  .base == "66203cc" and
  .head == "d5b2b68" and
  (.verdict as $v | (["approve", "findings"] | index($v)) != null) and
  ([.findings[].id] | length == (unique | length)) and
  all(.findings[]; . as $f |
    (["blocker", "major", "minor", "nit"] | index($f.severity)) != null and
    (["correctness", "security", "spec-conformance", "reliability", "style"] | index($f.category)) != null and
    ($f.file | type == "string") and
    ($f.line | type == "number") and
    ($f.claim | type == "string") and
    ($f.evidence | type == "string") and
    ($f.fix | type == "string")
  ) and
  all(.coverage[]; . as $c | (["read", "skimmed", "not-read"] | index($c.status)) != null) and
  ([.checklist[].item] | sort) == [range(1; 11)] and
  all(.checklist[]; . as $c | (["pass", "fail"] | index($c.status)) != null and ($c.evidence | type == "string"))
' docs/specs/CND-1_conductor-daemon/review.json
diff -u <(rg --files src test | sort) <(jq -r '.coverage[].file' docs/specs/CND-1_conductor-daemon/review.json | sort)","workdir":"/redacted","yield_time_ms":10000,"max_output_tokens":12000});
text(JSON.stringify({exit_code:r.exit_code,output:r.output}));
